_meta.note: Blackmere main-story elements for the Hunt journey spine (EF-HUNT-MAP-HANDOFF.md §4): the Stair-foot arrival camp, the Bowl-Keeper's shrine, and the Drowned Banquet dungeon door.
_meta.coords: zone svg coords (same frame as data/world-terrain/UW2.json — viewBox 0 0 150.48 150.52, y down)

elements.name: The Stair-foot Camp
elements.note: the arrival camp on the terrace at the Foot of the Diminishing Stair (UW2-STAIR-FOOT) — where the Cut is spoken and descenders first stand at Blackmere's scale

elements.name: The Bowl-Keeper's Alcove
elements.note: a lamplit alcove off the Stair-foot terrace where the Homeward Bowl is kept — the way back up for those the deep releases

elements.name: The Drowned Banquet — First Hall
elements.note: the door into the first of the five flooded halls of the Drowned Banquet (UW2-BANQUET, EPIC 1101096) — still set for a feast no one finished

elements.name: The Undertow
elements.note: the drowned shelf in UW2's far east, beyond the story's reach — where the Kraken leaves its catch (HUNT-TRAVEL §5b). Act-IV drag landing; loop-5-tuned enemies (unwinnable → RUN). Later cycles: persists as endgame hunting ground.

elements.name: The Sluice
elements.note: the one-way chute — dark tunnel mouth, wind moaning, slopes down; the ONLY way out of the Undertow. Slides you (no climbing back) toward the known exits near the Stair-foot. 'It's dark. It's windy. It slides down. Will you go down?' (the Cut's question again). HUNT-TRAVEL §5b.
